brief: Inspect the Willow Common transformer to clear bird nesting material packed into the upper ventilation grille and top up the oil level sight glass reading below the minimum mark at ambient [MG-023, MG-021]. Where an ageing unit cannot be attended before an event, apply the loading restriction in MG-021 in preference to accepting the exposure [MG-023]. Record every de-rating applied, the reason, the value and the period [MG-021].
